definitions.explanation: The inside of a building or enclosed space. Used as a noun or as a modifier (屋内の) to describe things located or happening indoors.

examples.japanese: {屋内|おくない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぼう→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{屋内|おくない}⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Since it was raining, we went to the indoor pool.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{屋内|おくない}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全面|ぜんめん}→全面：22735_zenmen⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧になっている。
examples.english: This facility is entirely non-smoking indoors.

notes:
FORMS:
{屋|おく} (roof, building) + ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屋内|おくない}⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧: indoor pool
- {屋内|おくない}⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: indoor parking garage
- {屋内|おくない}⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧: indoor sports
- {屋内|おくない}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: indoor facility
- {屋内|おくない}⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: no smoking indoors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {屋内|おくない}: indoors (inside a building — formal)
- ⟦{屋外|おくがい}→屋外：04136_okugai⟧: outdoors (outside a building — the antonym)
- ⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧: inside a room (more specific)
- ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: inside (general, casual)

USAGE:
More formal than ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ and specifically refers to being inside a building, not just any enclosed space. Common in signage, facility descriptions, and regulations.
